encounter: E0150 TRAINER_FLANNERY_1, Lavaridge Gym leader (sun + After You Eruption + Mega Chandelure), cap 36
availability_audit: Chronology: the Heat Badge fight is the last encounter of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney raised the cap to 36, C23 is Flannery). Every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Petalburg City ponds with the C02 Old Rod (C02), Dewford (C10-C14), Slateport Mart (C15), Mauville Game Corner and the C18 Rock Smash license (C18). No Surf-gated water (Surf is C27), no Strength-gated area (Strength comes only after this badge), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36.
plan: Win the weather war, then punish. Pelipper is deliberately NOT led: ability order on entry is by Speed, so a leading Pelipper's Drizzle resolves first and Torkoal's Drought simply overwrites it into sun. Pelipper is instead switched in on turn 1, which makes rain the newer weather and cancels Drought - halving every Fire attack including a sun-boosted Eruption and doubling my own Water damage. Every member except Primarina resists Grass, so Chlorophyll Lilligant's Leaf Storm has no easy target; Swampert is deliberately left out because it is 4x weak to it. Garganacl's Purifying Salt blanks Sacred Fire and Will-O-Wisp burns and halves Mega Chandelure's and Skeledirge's Ghost damage. Gyarados's Intimidate answers Incineroar and Band Entei.

party.role: primary rain sweeper; Water/Dragon resists Fire, Water AND Grass, which is every offensive type on Flannery's team
party.availability: Horsea on the Route104 good-rod table (gate 30), Seadra at level 32, Kingdra by Dragon Scale trade evolution.

party.role: Intimidate against Incineroar and Choice Band Entei; Water/Flying resists Fire and Grass
party.availability: Magikarp on the Petalburg City old-rod table (gate 14), evolves at level 20.

party.role: weather answer, switched in rather than led so its Drizzle lands after Drought
party.availability: Wingull on the Route103 land table (gate 14), evolves to Pelipper at level 25.

party.role: Rock Slide is 2x on five of Flannery's six; Purifying Salt is immune to Sacred Fire burn and halves Ghost damage from Mega Chandelure and Skeledirge
party.availability: Altering Cave 1F rock-smash table (gate 30); Rock Smash license from Mauville (C18).

party.role: redirection; Fairy/Flying resists Grass and is the safest switch into Lilligant
party.availability: Togepi on the Route102 land table (gate 14), friendship evolution to Togetic, Shiny Stone from the Slateport Mart (C15).

party.role: Assault Vest special wall and second Water breaker; Icy Wind is the speed answer if the sun stays up and Chlorophyll turns on
party.availability: Popplio from the Mauville Game Corner (500 coins, C18), Brionne at 17, Primarina at 34.
